title: Easter Island's statues may have walked, then been reshaped
caption: Two archaeologists say Easter Island's statues walked to their platforms, then were reshaped to stand still.
description:
Two archaeologists, Carl Lipo and Terry Hunt, argue that Easter Island's statues were walked from the quarry, rocked side to side with ropes, and that the statues on the platforms were reshaped once they arrived: their bases trimmed so they stand straight, their eye sockets carved only then. Not everyone agrees. Other archaeologists think many of the statues along the old roads were set up there on purpose. So were they abandoned on the way, or meant to be there all along? What do you think?

3D illustration: statue proportions and crew sizes are illustrative, gold outlines show a reading rather than a reconstruction, the test replica's size is estimated from its weight, and the map is simplified and not to scale.
